variants.headline: Looking back: home world punishes the colony
variants.sub: A punishment has been imposed on {colony} by the home world.
variants.body:
We return to {first_reported}. Our report recorded this: The home world had punished the colony.

Punitive action deserves a careful commercial assessment, but its existence does not identify a cost. Owners and managers should not presume a particular restriction on trade, finance or materials from the label alone. The sensible approach is to distinguish the political event from its still unspecified operating terms.

The event remains part of the record. Whether subsequent developments met the standard it raised is a separate question, not something the old headline can answer by itself.

The position of {target} should be assessed without supplying an unreported offence or penalty. This paper records the punitive action while reserving judgment on particulars not established in the report.

variants.headline: Looking back: authority takes a punitive turn
variants.sub: The home world has punished the colony.
variants.body:

Punitive action deserves a careful commercial assessment, but its existence does not identify a cost. What has changed since then should be examined against that original record. What has not changed is the need to distinguish an established event from the hopes or fears attached to it.
